comment: Exists so `pnpm --filter @curator/schema typecheck` can check the zod mirror on its own. Before this, that script errored with TS5057 (no tsconfig), so the only thing ever type-checking these shapes was web/'s build — which means a lane that does not own web/ had no way to verify a schema change it had just made. Settings mirror web/tsconfig.json where it matters (strict, bundler resolution, ES2022) so a shape that checks here cannot fail there for a compiler-option reason.
